scenario: Autónomo, income 50,000, expenses 4,000, SS 3,600, VC, foreign clients only. The activity is stipulated to be established, past the new-activity periods, so the LIRPF art. 32.3 reduction does not apply. Each calculation below carries its own oracle, because the annual cuota íntegra and the quarterly advances are checked against different sources.

modelo130.oracleRef: Arithmetic under SPEC-003 §1, RD 439/2007 (RIRPF) art. 30.2ª and 110.1.a (boe.es consolidated text of BOE-A-2007-6820, read 2026-09-26) and AEAT, instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 02–19: under estimación directa simplificada casilla 02 includes difícil justificación of 5 % of the net to date, at most 2,000 a year. The inputs are Theory §7.3, ed. 2, Example B quarter by quarter, whose nets to date before difícil justificación are 8,100, 21,200, 27,300 and 42,400. With it they are 7,695, 20,140, 25,935 and 40,400 (the cap binds in Q4, where 5 % would be 2,120), so Σ 130 is 0.20 × 40,400 = 8,080. Example B leaves difícil justificación out of the 130 and gets 8,480, which is not the legal figure (#33). The theory table applies no minoración, so previousYear is set above the last band.

rentaTrueUp.oracleRef: Theory §7.2, ed. 2, Example B steps 1–10 for the inputs and the cuota íntegra estatal of 5,324.75 − 527.25 = 4,797.50. The theory takes the VC cuota as 5,250.00 − 499.50, applying the state mínimo of 5,550 to the regional scale; LIRPF art. 56.3 and 74.1 (boe.es consolidated Ley 35/2006, read 2026-09-26) apply the region's own mínimo instead, which for VC is 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis.1.a, boe.es consolidated BOE-A-1998-8202, read 2026-09-26; AEAT Manual práctico Renta 2025, cap. 14, Comunitat Valenciana: importes del mínimo personal y familiar). So the VC cuota is 5,250.00 − 549.45 = 4,700.55, the cuota íntegra 9,498.05. Theory §7.2 subtracts a Σ 130 of 8,480, which leaves difícil justificación out of the 130; with it in casilla 02 (the modelo130 part above) Σ 130 is 8,080.00 and the result is 1,418.05 a ingresar (#29, #33). With no employment income the whole cuota is the activity's, so liabilityOnActivity is the cuota íntegra and gap is the result. marginalRate is not in the theory; it is the tranche rates at a base of 40,400 (0.185 estatal + 0.175 VC).
